modules.description: Train and serve models with differential privacy, on-device adapters, and auditable inference trails for regulated cohorts.
Ingest heterogeneous corpora, resolve contradictions, and emit structured briefs with citation-backed claim graphs.
Isolate learner workspaces, quota GPU sandboxes, and visualize session lineage across orgs without cross-leakage.
Compose adaptive pathways from skill nodes, sync updates across institutions, and keep local policy envelopes intact.
Map prerequisite webs, surface mastery gaps, and recommend micro-drills using sparse graph attention over learner telemetry.
Stream formative signals from IDE and LMS hooks into a live radar of proficiency, effort, and collaboration quality.
